documents.title: PACCAR MX-13 EPA2013 aftertreatment software and false derate awareness
documents.summary: For applicable 2013-emissions PACCAR MX-13 chassis, Peterbilt bulletin E071 documented an engine software update addressing DEF quality/SCR reporting, DPF soot-load estimation, stationary regeneration behavior and false aftertreatment derate inducement. Diagnostic lesson: on an applicable early EPA2013 MX-13 with confusing SCR/DEF/DPF faults or false derate behavior, verify chassis applicability and current engine software/campaign status before condemning expensive aftertreatment hardware.

documents.title: PACCAR MX-13 EPA13 2013-2015A SCR configuration and NH3 sensor changes
documents.summary: Peterbilt bulletin E245 applies to specified PACCAR MX-13 EPA13 engine model years 2013 through 2015A and describes different physical/software actions depending on SCR configuration. Some configurations stop using the NH3 ammonia sensor after the update, while vertical SCR configurations receive additional hardware changes. Diagnostic lesson: identify exact engine model year and SCR configuration and verify campaign/software status before treating an NH3 sensor-related condition as a normal sensor failure.

documents.title: Mack MP8 Turbo Compound MY2017-2018 SCR recall applicability
documents.authority: OEM Mack Trucks recall EC0033 / M0311
documents.source: NHTSA archived Mack recall M0311, September 2024
documents.summary: Mack recall M0311 concerns certain vehicles with MY2017 or MY2018 MP8 Turbo Compound engines whose monitored SCR NOx conversion efficiency fell below the recall criterion, or whose telematics stopped reporting for the specified period. This is VIN-specific recall information, not a universal MP8 diagnosis. Panta should advise checking VIN recall applicability rather than assuming every low SCR-efficiency MP8 requires the recall repair.

documents.title: Allison 6th Gen 4500 P0848-00 on certain Peterbilt chassis
documents.summary: Peterbilt bulletin 27-010 identifies an incorrect transmission harness on a limited population of certain Peterbilt 367, 389, 567 and 589 chassis built 2022-04-26 through 2023-11-15 with Allison 6th Gen 4500-series 6-speed transmissions. Applicable chassis may set P0848-00 Fluid Pressure Switch. The bulletin calls for diagnosis with Allison DOC and a test drive before repair, with a harness re-pin procedure for affected trucks. Do not generalize this fix to other Allison P0848-00 applications.

documents.title: Bendix ABS wheel speed sensor diagnostic checks
documents.authority: OEM Bendix wheel speed sensor checklist
documents.source: NHTSA archived Bendix Wheel Speed Sensor Checklist BW8003 reference
documents.summary: Bendix's wheel-speed-sensor checklist directs technicians to inspect sensor cables/connectors first, then test the suspected sensor at ambient temperature. The checklist gives an operable resistance range of 1200-2700 ohms and calls for at least 0.25 VAC while rotating the raised wheel at a minimum of about one-half revolution per second. If voltage is low, gently reposition the sensor toward the exciter ring and retest. If resistance and voltage are acceptable, investigate harness/ECU connections rather than automatically replacing the sensor. Follow Bendix safety and ECU service-data procedures.

documents.title: Allison on-highway fluid filter and Prognostics applicability
documents.authority: OEM Allison Transmission Service Information Letter 10-TR-99 Rev Y
documents.source: NHTSA archived Allison SIL 10-TR-99 Rev Y, March 2022
documents.summary: Allison SIL 10-TR-99 Rev Y covers fluid/filter recommendations across multiple commercial on-highway families. Prognostics availability and fluid compatibility vary by model year, serial number and calibration. Allison notes that 3000/4000 transmissions using Prognostics require Genuine Allison High-Capacity filters, while 1000/2000 units using Prognostics require the specified Genuine Allison control-main spin-on filter. Diagnostic/service lesson: identify transmission series, serial number, calibration and whether Prognostics is enabled before applying an interval or fluid rule.
